The Idea

One membership. Every drop.

Instead of hunting for tickets game by game, you join once. Every month you get credits. When a game you want opens up, you join the waitlist — no credits spent until you're actually allocated tickets.

If you're selected, credits are deducted and you get a confirmation email.

05

Tickets Emailed

Your tickets are transferred straight to your inbox before gameday.

How Allocation Works

Fair, transparent, credit-safe

When demand is below availability, tickets are confirmed instantly. When demand exceeds availability, here’s what happens:

01

Request

Members request tickets during the drop window.

02

Allocate

GameDay.VIP allocates the available tickets.

03

Deduct

Successful members have their credits deducted.

04

Protect

Unsuccessful members keep all their credits.

05

Prioritize

Members who miss out may get priority for a future comparable drop.

You never lose credits for tickets you don’t get.
How We Unlock Discounted Tickets

Rush drops, up to 50% off

Teams and venues release unsold inventory close to gametime. GameDay.VIP grabs it first and passes the discount straight to members.

01

Follow the Game

Follow or unlock an event in advance to get on the list for its Rush drop.

02

Get the Alert

GameDay.VIP sends a notification the moment Rush or discounted inventory opens.

03

Reserve Fast

A short 5–10 minute reservation window to grab your seats before they're gone.

04

Buy Up To 2

Purchase up to two tickets per Rush drop, at up to 50% off marketplace prices.

05

Get In

Tickets are delivered digitally or ready for pickup at the venue.

Rush drops move fast — reserve within the window or they go to the next member in line.

FAQs

Good to know

No. Joining a waitlist is always free. Credits are only deducted if you're successfully allocated tickets.

You keep 100% of your credits. Nothing is deducted unless you're one of the members allocated tickets for that game.

Credits roll over month to month as long as your membership stays active.

If you're allocated tickets, you'll get a confirmation email and your tickets will be transferred to you separately by email ahead of the game.

GameDay.VIP memberships are 12-month agreements rather than cancel-anytime plans — this is what lets you build credits over time and use them when the tickets you want become available. You can manage your membership details anytime from your account settings, and our team is happy to help with any changes.

The pilot is currently live in Los Angeles, our test market, and capped at 500 members. New cities are coming soon — join now and we’ll notify you as soon as GameDay.VIP launches near you.

Anything from a last-minute standard seat (30–60 credits) up to a major VIP experience (1,000+ credits). See the full breakdown above — credits roll over, so you can save up for something bigger.

Through Rush drops. Teams and venues release unsold inventory close to gametime — you follow or unlock an event in advance, we alert you the moment that discounted inventory opens, and you get a short 5–10 minute window to reserve up to two tickets before they're gone. Tickets are delivered digitally or ready for pickup at the venue.

GameDay.VIP allocates the available tickets among members who requested them. Only successful members have credits deducted — everyone else keeps their credits, and may get priority for a future comparable drop.

A confirmation email, a digital ticket-transfer email, an event reminder, and instructions for mobile entry — all sent to your registered email address.
